name: Harness mobile
description:
1. **Harness view, mobile layout** — `HarnessView.vue` now shows one pane at a time on phones (`list → detail → task`) with a "‹ Tasks" back button, while desktop keeps the draggable 3-pane splitter; secondary table columns hide below `md`.
2. **Kanban board memory** — `store/kanban.js` persists the last opened board per project (`lastKanbanBoard:<project_id>`) with a validated `lastBoardId` getter, and `KanbanBoardView.vue` restores it on fresh entry instead of defaulting to `allBoards[0]`.
3. **Legacy board container** — `store/project.js` and `KanbanContainer.vue` got an equivalent `lastBoard` memory so chat/Vibe panels also reopen the right board.
4. **Header compaction** — the four stat cards were replaced by one row of coloured icon chips (runs · worker · heartbeat · watchdog), `live`/Refresh became icon buttons, and the run status pill text hides on mobile.
5. **Open issue flagged** — an in-progress `/:projectName/profiles/:name/edit` route exists in `router/index.ts` but `ProfileEditorView.vue` does not, so that page will fail until a separate session adds the file.

Remember last board opened in Kanban.

Now I have the full picture. Let me implement the changes, starting with the store (last board memory).Now the harness view mobile adaptation:Now wire the routed Kanban view to remember and restore the board:## Done — changes are on disk (Vite HMR reloaded them without errors)

### 1. Harness view adapted for mobile
`client/src/views/HarnessView.vue`
- New `mobilePane` state (`list` → `detail` → `task`): on a phone the three panes are shown **one at a time** instead of a half-width row (the splitter's non-split fallback used to render list + diagnosis + chat side by side, each ~⅓ of the screen).
- `showRunList / showRunDetail / showDiagnosis / showTaskPane` drive the splitter's `show-left` / `show-right`, so on desktop nothing changes (all panes visible, draggable, layouts still persisted).
- Drill-down controls: **“‹ Tasks”** back button above the diagnosis, and the task-pane header button becomes **‹ back** on mobile (✕ on desktop). `selectRun` / `openTask` / `closeTask` move the pane level; selecting the already-preselected run still navigates away from the list (it would otherwise be unreachable).
- Responsive chrome: `p-2 sm:p-4`, `text-base sm:text-lg`, subtitle hidden below `sm`, worker/watchdog strip `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4`.

`HarnessTaskTable.vue` — secondary columns (chat status, profile, duration, updated) hidden below `md`; `HarnessRunDetail.vue` — tab bar can scroll (`max-w-full overflow-x-auto`).

### 2. Kanban remembers the last board opened
- `client/src/store/kanban.js` — `LAST_BOARD_KEY` store **per project** (`lastKanbanBoard:<project_id>`) + `lastOpenedBoardId` state, `lastBoardId` getter (validates against existing boards, so a deleted/renamed board is ignored), `rememberBoard` action, and `loadKanban` hydrates the memory.
- `client/src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue` (the routed `/:projectName/kanban` view) — `initialBoardId` now falls back to `lastBoardId` instead of `allBoards[0]`; the `activeBoardId` watcher records every selection; the `boards` watcher reopens the remembered board when nothing else resolved.
- `client/src/store/project.js` + `KanbanContainer.vue` (legacy board container used by Vibe/chat panels) — equivalent memory (`lastBoard:<project>`, `restoreActiveBoard`), and `projectChanged` no longer resets the selection to the board list on every entry.

### Confirmed / ruled out
- Confirmed: all touched files compile (vite HMR in `codx-junior-client` logged plain `hmr update` for each file, no errors); no test suite covers these components (`project_locate` found none), so verification is visual.
- Ruled out: it is **not** a router problem — the route already carries `/:board`, the gap was purely the "fresh entry with no board in the URL" path.
- Known smell to unify later: two localStorage keys exist because the old `KanbanContainer` and the routed `KanbanBoardView` keep separate state (`lastBoard` vs `lastKanbanBoard`). Both work; consolidating them into one store action is a 10-line follow-up.

### Next concrete step (needs your call)
I can verify the mobile layout end-to-end (open Harness at 390 px width, drill list → run → task, then reload the Kanban twice to confirm the board is remembered) using a shared browser session — say the word and I'll run it, or reopen the client on your phone and I'll fix whatever still looks cramped.
